name: Time
description: Formats an absolute or relative date and time.

attributes.name: datetime
attributes.description: Sets an international date and time string.

examples.title: Display formats
examples.description: Show a date, a date with time, or a relative label.

examples.title: Different times
examples.description: Format morning, evening, midnight, and noon values.
examples.markup:
<noora-time datetime="2023-06-15T08:30:00Z" show-time></noora-time>
<noora-time datetime="2023-06-15T19:45:00Z" show-time></noora-time>
<noora-time datetime="2023-06-15T00:00:00Z" show-time></noora-time>
<noora-time datetime="2023-06-15T12:00:00Z" show-time></noora-time>

examples.title: Relative times
examples.description: Show relative labels with absolute tooltips.
examples.markup:
<noora-time datetime="2023-01-01T11:58:00Z" relative></noora-time>
<noora-time datetime="2022-12-31T12:00:00Z" relative></noora-time>
<noora-time datetime="2022-12-25T12:00:00Z" relative></noora-time>
<noora-time datetime="2022-01-01T12:00:00Z" relative></noora-time>

examples.title: Special dates
examples.description: Handle new year, leap day, and distant-future dates.
